listings.name: House of Nanking
listings.label: House of Nanking
listings.tagline: Peter and Lily Fang’s Shanghainese home cooking, Nanking sesame chicken and sizzling fried rice on Kearny Street since 1988.
listings.siteNote: Prices are from the restaurant’s May 2025 lunch and dinner menu. The restaurant notes that prices are subject to change.

panels.head: Family style
body: Every dish is served family style. Ask the kitchen to choose for the table, or order the chef’s choice menu.

panels.head: Groups and catering
body: Groups of five or fewer walk in. Groups of six or more reserve by email. Catering goes through the family’s sister restaurant, FANG.
